name: EU AI Act
source_version: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 as materially amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744
allowed_use_boundary: Use as external legal/regulatory AI crosswalk evidence.
Preserve EU AI Act-native terminology and current amendment relationships.
Use legal source identity and timing as policy/review context, not as a fact-specific legal conclusion.
Do not treat as legal advice, certification, regulator endorsement, standing, execution authority, or commit-time authority.
claims: The EU AI Act source set can support obligations, risk classes, documentation, oversight, prohibited-practice, and application-timeline comparison.
Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 materially amends Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and therefore belongs in the current legal-source reconstruction.
The current legal source set can be mapped to policy reference and governance boundary terms.
non_claims: The EU AI Act source set does not prove transition admissibility.
Regulatory compliance does not automatically grant execution authority inside StegVerse.
The wiki relationship record is not legal advice, a compliance determination, certification, regulator endorsement, or acceptance of equivalence.
